definitions.short: Eshcol , the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine
definitions.full: H812. Eshkol אֶשְׁכֹּל proper name 1. masculine an Amorite, brother of Mamre, dwelling in neighbourhood of Hebron Gen 14:13 , 24 . 2 in combination אֶשְׁכֹּל נַחַל Num 13:23 ; Deut 1:24 ; ׳נ אֶשְׁכּוֺל Num 13:24 ; 32:9 ; — valley of Eshcol , = valley of a cluster , region of Hebron (compare 13:22 ); in 13:24 derived from ׳א cluster , q. v.; see however Di on the passage
